{{Quote|Every clone has an identifying code on their wrist. Your military records will be in the database. Scan him, Artoo.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]], to [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]]|<ref name="Missing in Action">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref>}}
An '''identifying code''' was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], in order to identify and distinguish [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. The code was inserted into a [[Cloning/Legends|clones']] left wrist and would link [[Droid/Legends|droids]], such as [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromechs]], to the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper's]] file in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] military database.
